objective: Extract gameplay systems, entities, and relationships from requirements and map them to Unity module candidates.

steps.title: Review requirements files
steps.description: Open requirements.md and requirements.json. Identify top-level systems: Character, Equipment, Blessings, Cards, Combat, Progression, Save/Performance/Testing constraints.

steps.title: Extract entities and relationships
steps.description: List entity types and key properties (Card, Blessing, Equipment, SkillNode, SkillBranch, Class, Enemy). Create a table mapping entity -> fields -> relationships.

steps.title: Map systems to Unity modules
steps.description: Map Data definitions to ScriptableObjects and runtime managers to MonoBehaviours/Services. Record mapping with rationale.

steps.title: Cross-check with JSON schemas
steps.description: Open schema files and compare properties to extracted fields. Note mismatches and propose amendments.

steps.title: Produce a mapping artifact
steps.description: Create mapping.json with system, ScriptableObject name/path, manager names, and referenced schemas.

steps.title: Determine generation strategy for C# models
steps.description: Decide between auto-generation and manual class creation; document chosen approach.

steps.title: Validation and sign-off
steps.description: Verify completeness and presence of mapping.json; mark task complete.

notes: Prefer conservative ScriptableObject shapes and extend with composition.
Annotate schema gaps with TODOs for later revision.
Use id fields for stable cross-references.
